title: Oil flows through Middle East chokepoints increased in the third quarter
summary: Collective oil shipments through key chokepoints around the Middle East increased by 19% in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26), according to our recently published Global Energy Security Data.

summary: Working natural gas in storage in the Lower 48 states ended the natural gas injection season at 3,810 billion cubic feet (Bcf), exceeding the five-year average by almost 2%, according to estimates based on data from our Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report released on November 12. title: How does EIA account for small differences between energy supply and demand data?
summary: EIA uses over 60 surveys to collect data on the U.S. energy sector's supply and demand. In theory, supply and demand should balance. In practice, we often have small differences between our total supply and total demand figures.

summary: After decades of decline, crude oil production in Alaska is growing, driven by two projects on Alaska's North Slope. title: U.S. crude oil imports from Venezuela in July were highest since 2017
summary: In July 2026, U.S. imports of crude oil from Venezuela averaged 701,000 barrels per day (b/d), the most since May 2017, before decreasing to 655,000 b/d in August, according to data published in our Petroleum Supply Monthly

title: The share of solar generation with co-located battery storage is increasing
summary: Utility-scale solar developers are increasingly co-locating battery storage with new solar photovoltaic capacity. As of September 2026, over 16% of new utility-scale solar capacity added this year is co-located with operable battery storage, compared with 2% in 2017, according to data reported to EIA by operators.

title: LNG imports make up increasing share of Colombia's natural gas supply
summary: Colombia is importing more liquefied natural gas (LNG) as domestic production continues to fall. summary: The U.S. refinery fleet has run at higher-than-normal rates this year, with refinery utilization averaging more than 95% of capacity between May and September, the highest for those months since 1998. title: PJM, ERCOT, and SWPP all set peak load records this summer
summary: Three regional transmission organizations (RTOs) set records for peak hourly load this past summer, according to data reported on Form EIA-930 and presented in the Hourly Electric Grid Monitor.

title: Monthly wind generation in ISO-NE is about 68% higher than last year
summary: Monthly wind generation in the first nine months of 2026 was an average of 68% higher compared with the same period in 2025 in ISO New England (ISO-NE).

title: Mixed outlook for energy expenditures this winter
summary: We expect energy expenditures this winter to vary because of diverging trends in energy prices among fuels and regional variation in forecast temperatures. title: Crude oil prices and refinery margins generally increased throughout the third quarter
summary: Petroleum markets in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26) were characterized by increasing prices for crude oil and petroleum products amid persistent conflict in the Middle East.

title: U.S. natural gas production reached a record high in July 2026
summary: U.S. natural gas production hit an all-time high in July 2026, driven primarily by increased output in the Permian Basin, according to our latest Natural Gas Monthly.
